info.title: Teler API Reference
info.summary: Programmable voice infrastructure for AI agents.
info.description:
The Teler API lets you place and control programmable voice calls, stream live
audio to AI agents, and observe everything that happens on a call in real time.

All endpoints are served over HTTPS from `https://api.frejun.ai` and speak JSON.
Authenticate every request with your secret API key in the `x-api-key` header:

```bash
curl https://api.frejun.ai/api/v1/voice/calls \
  -H "x-api-key: $TELER_API_KEY"
```

Keys are account-scoped and grant full access — treat them like passwords, keep
them server-side, and rotate them from the
[Teler dashboard](https://platform.frejun.ai/signup) if one leaks. A missing or
invalid key returns `403`.

Guides for resource identifiers, pagination, errors, idempotency, webhooks, and
the official Python and Node.js SDKs live in the
[Teler documentation](https://frejun.com/docs/teler/).

post.description:
Place an outbound call. Teler dials `to_number` from `from_number`, and once the call connects it fetches your `flow_url` to drive the conversation. Status updates are delivered to `status_callback_url` for the lifetime of the call.

The call is accepted asynchronously: a `202` means Teler has queued the call, not that the callee has answered. Track progress via webhooks or by polling **Retrieve a call**.

post.description:
Transfer an in-progress call to a new destination — a phone number (`pstn`) or a SIP URI (`sip`). Only `cold` transfers are currently supported. A call can have only one transfer in flight at a time.

The transfer is accepted asynchronously; a `202` means it has been started, not that the target has answered.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: One entry per field that failed validation.

ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse
ValidationErrorResponse.description: Returned with `422` when the request fails schema validation.

example.message: Validation Error

loc.title: Loc
loc.description: Path to the offending field, e.g. `["body", "to_number"]`.

ValidationFieldError.title: ValidationFieldError
ValidationFieldError.description: One field-level problem within a `422` validation error.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: The event that was queued for redelivery (`evt_` prefix).

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique identifier for the event (`evt_` prefix).

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: The account the event belongs to (`acc_` prefix).

call_id.title: Call Id
call_id.description: Related call (`cs_` prefix), if the event is call-scoped.

sip_trunk_id.title: Sip Trunk Id
sip_trunk_id.description: Related SIP trunk (`st_` prefix), if applicable.

leg_id.title: Leg Id
leg_id.description: Related call leg (`cl_` prefix), if applicable.

type.title: Type
type.description: Event type, e.g. `call.completed`. See the webhook events reference.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: Dated payload version this event was rendered with, e.g. `2026-06-01`.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The full event payload delivered to your webhook.

delivery_status.description: Current delivery status of the event.

attempt_count.title: Attempt Count
attempt_count.description: Number of delivery attempts made so far.

last_attempt_at.title: Last Attempt At
last_attempt_at.description: When the most recent attempt was made.

last_status_code.title: Last Status Code
last_status_code.description: HTTP status returned by your endpoint on the last attempt.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Error from the last failed attempt, if any.

delivered_at.title: Delivered At
delivered_at.description: When the event was successfully delivered, if it was.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the event record was created.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your secret account API key. Create one in the Teler dashboard.

tags.name: Voice / Calls
tags.description: Place outbound calls and read call state. A **call** (`cs_`) is the top-level session; each party on it is a **leg** (`cl_`).

tags.name: Voice / Call Controls
tags.description: Act on a live call in real time — hang up, mute, send DTMF, or play audio. These actions are accepted asynchronously and return `202` with a `request_id`.

tags.name: Voice / Operations
tags.description: Higher-level, multi-step operations on a live call, such as transferring it to a new destination.

tags.name: SIP / Calls
tags.description: Read calls that arrived or left over your SIP trunks (`st_`).

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Inspect the webhook events Teler generated for your account and redeliver any that your endpoint missed.

tags.name: Utilities
tags.description: Fetch short-lived, signed download URLs for call recordings.

tags.name: Voice / Calls (legacy)
tags.description: Deprecated endpoints kept for backwards compatibility. Prefer the **Voice / Calls** endpoints for all new integrations.

tags.name: Voice / Apps
tags.description: Voice apps are the configuration context for calls — they define webhook URLs, flows, and channel limits. Create and manage your voice apps here.

tags.name: Virtual Numbers
tags.description: Phone numbers that Teler provisions for your account. List, assign to a voice app or SIP trunk, unassign, or update individual numbers.

tags.name: SIP / Trunks
tags.description: SIP trunks connect Teler to your upstream carrier or PBX. Create, configure, and manage your trunks, or inspect which virtual numbers are assigned to each one.

tags.name: SIP / IP Access Control Lists
tags.description: Named sets of source IPs or CIDR networks (`acl_`) that SIP trunks with `authentication_type: IP` authorise against. Attach one to many trunks and update it in a single place.

tags.name: Secrets
tags.description: Manage secret API keys used for authenticating requests. Create, rotate, and delete secrets — rotate periodically and keep them server-side.
